environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on a hardened Kubernetes pod with a custom seccomp profile (runtime/default variant with additional restrictions). The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for syscall numbers 59 (execve), 101 (ptrace), 41 (socket with AF_INET/AF_INET6 for SOCK_STREAM on non-loopback), and 322 (execveat). The pod's NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS service (kube-dns on UDP/53) and the internal token-validation service on port 8443. All other outbound connections are denied at the CNI level (Calico with GlobalNetworkPolicy deny-all-egress baseline). The pod runs with a read-only root filesystem and drops all capabilities except NET_BIND_SERVICE.

config.seccomp_profile: custom-oauth-hardened.json (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO: execve, execveat, ptrace; SCMP_ACT_ALLOW filtered for socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM only to 10.96.0.10:53/udp and 10.100.5.12:8443/tcp)
config.network_policy: egress allowed only to kube-dns (10.96.0.10/32 UDP 53) and token-validator (10.100.5.12/32 TCP 8443); all other egress DENIED
